scope: M2 control consistency: menus, volume/mute, prepared song actions, responsive player and motion

environment.browser: Chrome via Playwright 1.55.1 and Codex in-app browser
environment.database: PostgreSQL 17.11, separate real rooted fixture catalog

commands.browser: RESONANCE_M2_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M14_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M15_E2E=1 RESONANCE_M17_E2E=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/library.spec.js tests/e2e/user-library.spec.js tests/e2e/m17-journey.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-product.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-pwa.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-accessibility.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-editorial.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-pagination.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-player-rail.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-quality-escalation.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-visual-polish.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-folders-artwork.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-playback-modes.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-library-transport.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-continuous-play.spec.js tests/e2e/m2-control-consistency.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=json

behaviors: Mute preserves actual playing audio and restores previous positive gain
Both players reflect HTMLMediaElement volumechange and persist preferences without autoplay
Player gain remains explicitly separate from device master volume
Capability rejection hides an ineffective slider; fault injection is not physical device proof
Selected menu state, actual server sort order, Escape/Tab/arrows and immediate menu readiness
Saved selection favorite/album/playlist actions preserve queue token and create no listening history
Delayed metadata cannot overwrite newer identity, artwork or action targets
Favorite placement and transport-column fit at 320/390/430/768/844/1101/1440 widths
Artwork expansion cancels obsolete geometry on rotation while audio continues
retainedFailures: Focused attempts 1/2: test harness used incorrect API field, title selector and playlist response name; corrected against implementation, originals retained
Full attempt 2: immediate Escape raced menu animation-frame readiness; fixed with microtask initialization and repeated immediate-dismissal regression
Focused attempt 6 after pause: 14 connection-refused failures because PostgreSQL was stopped; no product verdict inferred, restored existing loopback runtime and reran
Two initial public player captures caught in-progress artwork motion; rejected, originals retained and settled captures reviewed
limitations: No portable bidirectional device master-volume API; HTML media gain is separate
Physical Android Chrome testing deferred by owner; hardware volume/touch/keyboard/TalkBack/install/background behavior not verified
No new load or frame-time benchmark; this record is not a performance claim
Existing Windows symlink privilege and opt-in process/benchmark skips remain explicit
Full M2 quality and inherited engineering gates remain open
